name: Rein handler
design: Very tall slender adult female Yautja with cool grey mottled hide, long swept-back skull, distinct four slender mandibles, high-tied heavy scalp tendrils falling down her back. Long muted sage sleeveless workcoat with asymmetrical buttonless overlap, narrow tan apron and crossbody soft pouch. A tidy coil of broad braided reins rests over left forearm; right hand loosely holds a bronze harness buckle. Slim upright silhouette, calm exposed alien face.
